beats.title: One model is not one operating system
beats.body: A stronger model changes the work only when routing, evidence, and approval gates change with it.

beats.title: Route work by risk and latency
beats.body: Use the frontier model for ambiguous decisions, a balanced model for implementation, and a fast model for bounded checks.

beats.title: Pilot speed versus production trust
beats.body: Rapid visual pilots optimize learning. Production runs add approved facts, timed audio, render QA, and publish handoff.

beats.title: Evidence drives the visual decision
beats.body: Retrieve approved style evidence, score package fit, record the selection trace, then validate layout continuity.

beats.title: Promote only what can be audited
beats.body: A pilot becomes production input only after script, sources, timing, map, render, and approvals bind to exact hashes.
